title: Admin - Partner Management - Bulk Upload Entry Point - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin Partner Management - Bulk Upload Entry Point feature on the Y4J platform. This feature provides a 'Bulk Upload' button on the Partner Management screen that opens a bulk upload modal for uploading multiple vendors quickly. Covers button visibility, modal opening, upload flow, authorization, and error handling.

testCases.title: Bulk Upload button is visible on Partner Management screen
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin (Super Admin). Partner Management page is loaded.
steps: Navigate to Partner Management page from the sidebar
Observe the toolbar/action area on the page
expectedResults: The 'Bulk Upload' button is visible on the Partner Management page
The button is clearly labeled (text reads 'Bulk Upload' or similar)
The button is positioned in the toolbar/action area
The button is clickable and not disabled
testCases.postconditions: Bulk Upload button is confirmed visible and accessible

testCases.title: Clicking Bulk Upload opens the bulk upload modal
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Partner Management page is loaded with Bulk Upload button visible.
expectedResults: Clicking the button opens a bulk upload modal/dialog
The modal is displayed over the page content
The modal contains upload-related UI elements (file input, instructions, etc.)
The modal has a title/heading indicating bulk upload purpose
The modal has a way to close/cancel
testCases.postconditions: Bulk upload modal is open and ready for use

testCases.title: Modal follows the upload flow
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Bulk upload modal is open.
steps: Verify the modal contains file selection/upload functionality
expectedResults: The modal contains a file upload area (drag-and-drop or file picker)
Instructions for the upload format are provided (e.g., CSV template, required columns)
An upload/submit button is available
The flow is clear and guides the admin through the bulk upload process
testCases.postconditions: Upload flow is accessible within the modal

testCases.title: Bulk Upload button is hidden for unauthorized users
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as a Limited-Access Admin without Partner Management permission.
steps: Log in as a Limited-Access Admin without bulk upload permission
Navigate to Partner Management page (if accessible)
expectedResults: The 'Bulk Upload' button is NOT visible for unauthorized users
OR the button is disabled/greyed out with appropriate tooltip
Unauthorized users cannot access the bulk upload functionality
No error occurs — the button is simply not rendered
testCases.postconditions: Unauthorized users cannot see or access Bulk Upload

testCases.title: Modal can be closed without uploading
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Bulk upload modal is open.
steps: Close the modal without uploading (click X, press Escape, or click Cancel)
expectedResults: The modal closes without performing any upload
No data is uploaded or modified
The Partner Management page returns to its normal state
No error messages are shown
testCases.postconditions: Modal is closed without side effects

testCases.title: Bulk Upload button is keyboard accessible
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Partner Management page is loaded.
steps: Tab through the page to reach the Bulk Upload button
Press Enter or Space to activate the button
expectedResults: The Bulk Upload button is reachable via Tab key
A visible focus indicator appears on the button
Enter/Space opens the bulk upload modal
The button is fully keyboard accessible

testCases.title: Modal handles failure to open gracefully
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A condition exists that might prevent modal from opening (e.g., JavaScript error).
steps: Click the Bulk Upload button under normal conditions
If the modal fails to open, observe the error handling
expectedResults: Under normal conditions, the modal opens successfully
If a failure occurs, an error message is displayed (e.g., 'Unable to open upload dialog')
The page does not crash or become unresponsive
The user can retry by clicking the button again

testCases.title: Bulk Upload button does not conflict with other navigation
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Partner Management page is loaded.
steps: Verify the modal opens (not a page navigation)
Verify the user is still on the Partner Management page
expectedResults: Clicking Bulk Upload opens a modal (not a new page or navigation)
The URL does not change when the modal opens
After closing the modal, the user remains on Partner Management
No navigation conflict occurs
testCases.postconditions: No navigation conflict with Bulk Upload

testCases.title: Bulk Upload button is visible after page refresh
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Partner Management page is loaded.
steps: Verify the Bulk Upload button is visible
Verify the button is still visible after refresh
expectedResults: After page refresh, the Bulk Upload button remains visible
The button is functional after refresh
No rendering issues occur

testCases.title: Bulk Upload button has appropriate accessible name
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Partner Management page is loaded.
steps: Verify it has an accessible name for screen readers
expectedResults: The button has a clear accessible name (e.g., 'Bulk Upload' or 'Upload multiple vendors')
Screen readers can identify the button's purpose
The button has appropriate role='button' or is a <button> element
testCases.postconditions: Button is accessible to assistive technologies
